arguments.message:
Sure! To set up an automated weekly export:
1. Open **Settings → Data → Scheduled exports**.
2. Click **Create new schedule**.
3. Choose the data you want to export.
4. Set the recurrence to **Weekly**.
5. Connect a cloud‑storage destination (e.g., Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive) via the OAuth prompt – you only need to do this once per destination.
6. Save the schedule.
The export will now run automatically each week and drop the file into the connected storage, so you won’t need to download it manually.
If you need any help picking a storage provider or selecting the export format, just let me know!
